name: Gladbeck (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Gladbeck (crossed hammers on black and black figures on yellow beneath a mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Gladbeck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gladbeck arms — hammers and figures with mural crown
